INSERT INTO invites
             (user_id, code, max_uses, expires_at, autofollow, comment, created_at, updated_at)
           SELECT t.user_id, t.code, $3, $4, false, $5, now(), now()
           FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[]) AS t(user_id, code)
           ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
